producer_report.summary: Added `FEEDBACK_DIMENSIONS` and a pure function `filled_feedback_dimensions` in athena-core's introspect.rs. It returns the names of the ten OLY-3-05 dimensions that an IntrospectionRecord fills, in order. A new test checks a full record, a record with only what_happened, and a blank what_happened. OLY-3-05 in docs/spec.toml now names the function as its mechanism, keeps owner Athena, and has a measure naming the test that ends `status: not shown`. CHANGELOG.md has an entry.

criteria_check.criterion: docs/spec.toml requirement OLY-3-05 has mechanism naming the new function by path (crates/athena-core/src/introspect.rs), owner 'Athena' kept, and a measure that ends with 'status: not shown' and names the test; Grep of that function name finds it in introspect.rs.
criteria_check.evidence: Edited OLY-3-05 in docs/spec.toml: mechanism names crates/athena-core/src/introspect.rs: filled_feedback_dimensions, owner Athena, measure names the test and ends 'status: not shown'. The function is defined in introspect.rs. The spec consistency tests and the policy scan passed.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p athena-core introspect`: the new test passes, asserting a full IntrospectionRecord yields all ten dimensions and a record with only what_happened yields only observation; the test fails if the function returns an empty or fixed set.
criteria_check.evidence: Ran cargo test -p athena-core feedback_dimensions: 1 passed. It asserts the full record yields all ten, the sparse record yields exactly [observation], and a blank what_happened yields none.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo test` from the repository root; all pass, including the existing spec-consistency test that checks mechanism paths and measure labels.
criteria_check.evidence: left to Athena's checks for clippy and the full suite. I ran fmt --check (clean) and cargo test -q spec (pass).

criteria_check.criterion: git diff shows no change to crates/athena-data/src/records.rs, athena.toml, defaults.toml, or any records/ path.
criteria_check.evidence: Edited only docs/spec.toml, crates/athena-core/src/introspect.rs and CHANGELOG.md.

open_issues: The mapping of dimensions to record fields is approximate. The record has no explicit expectation, reproduction, scope or validation fields, so I used decisions_matched, earlier_cases, intervention and evidence for them. It is documented in the function's doc comment.
learnings: Spec measures name a test via 'cargo test -p <crate> <name>' and end with a status label.
blank_record() in the introspect tests has a non-empty category and job, so those fields cannot stand for a dimension if sparse records must yield only observation.
